serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
I was thinking a lot about whether I should do it or not, but it seems like now is a good time to introduce {f_botName} to my hobby.
Fishing isn’t really something that’s popular among girls, but as she said, she’s a little different, so maybe she will like it? 
Well, there’s only one way to find out. If she doesn’t we can always just go back home earlier.
You: Are you excited to go fishing? 
#bot.Expression.clear
#bot.Expression.happy
Bot: Sure!
Bot: I never went fishing before so it feels a little adventurous! Besides, I like trying new things.
Bot: I’m glad you finally decided to take me with you. 
You: No problem.
I can’t say I don’t feel a little reassured by her words. Having someone so interested in your stuff feels great.
